chain_words.nuance: to think something is probably true, without proof
to assume something as a reasonable working idea
to hold something as true with confidence
to keep firmly to a position in an argument
to argue firmly and persistently that something is the case

explanation: These words all describe holding a view, from a tentative suspicion to a firm, persistent argument.

usage_notes.difference: 'Believe' means holding something as true; 'maintain' means keeping that position firmly, especially when challenged in an argument.
